## Summary
William Ma is an ML Engineering Manager with a strong background in building
production ML systems, MLOps platforms, and data infrastructure at scale.
He has driven significant business impact across fintech, insurtech, adtech,
and e-commerce domains. He is passionate about turning research into reliable,
high-throughput production systems and helping data science teams move faster.
